# bla5k — Best AI Tools Directory 2026

> bla5k is a curated, human-reviewed directory of the best AI tools, apps and
> communities. Every tool has an in-depth review: what it does, pricing, free
> tiers, pros/cons, and plain-language explainers. We cover coding, AI chat,
> design, video & audio, education, writing, agents and no-code builders.
> Updated weekly. Unbiased — reviews are independent and affiliate links are
> always disclosed.
